_comment: Content phasing for OctoWoW, taken from the official roadmap at https://octowow.st/roadmap.
The roadmap states dates are subject to change - update them here, never in markup.
Each phase lists the content it unlocks. The scraper resolves 'zones' entries to zone ids
using the merged zone-name map, then seeds its crawl with every NPC known to spawn in those
zones. Most bosses need no naming here - the crawler finds them by following an item's page
back to everything that drops it, which is what makes Turtle's custom instances workable
'npcs' covers the cases that discovery cannot reach:
- roaming world bosses, which belong to no instance zone;
- summoned or scripted encounters that have no spawn entry AND whose loot is exclusive to
them, so no other item page ever mentions them. Nefarian is the type case: he is not in
the spawn table, and only he drops his tier pieces, so nothing else can lead to him.
Names are resolved through the database search, and anything that fails to resolve is listed
in data/meta.json under unresolved.npcNames rather than failing silently.
_atlasComment: Loot now comes primarily from the Atlas-CFM addon's database, which is curated for this
server family: it carries drop rates, names and orders every encounter, and keeps each
instance separate - including the custom ones the website's zone data cannot tell apart.
'atlasInstances' names the instances a phase unlocks, using Atlas's own keys (run the scraper
with --atlas-report to list them). Anything not named under a phase is treated as available at
launch, so only gated content needs listing here.

phases.name: Launch
phases.blurb: The unphased 1.18.1 restoration. Everything available before the phase rollout begins: Molten Core, Onyxia, the Turtle custom dungeons and raids, world bosses, reputations and crafting.
_lowerKarazhanHallsComment: Lower Karazhan Halls is Launch content (10-man, T1) but cannot be separated here. The
database has two Karazhan zones: 'Karazhan' (2562) holds no spawns at all, and 'Tower of
Karazhan' (3457) holds all 106 of them - the lower halls and the Phase 7 tower share it.
Rather than guess a split, the zone stays with Phase 7 where the roadmap puts Karazhan, so
some gear reachable today is currently shown one phase late. Fix this by adding the right
zone id to zoneIdOverrides once the two are distinguishable.
_zonesComment: Open-world zones are deliberately absent. Seeding a zone crawls every NPC that spawns in
it, and a zone like Winterspring or Felwood is thousands of pages of trash that drops
nothing a level 60 would slot. Named world bosses are listed under 'npcs' instead, and any
world-drop epic that a tracked boss also drops is still picked up through the item pages.

phases.name: Phase 1
phases.blurb: An ancient magic is felt in the heart of the Stranglethorn Vale as the lost city of Zul'Gurub stirs to life.
phases.headline: Zul'Gurub

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.blurb: Nefarian's experiments spill from the depths of Blackrock Mountain. Storm Blackwing Lair and put an end to the corrupted broods of the black dragonflight.
phases.headline: Blackwing Lair

phases.name: Phase 3
phases.blurb: The Nightmare bleeds into the waking world. Journey into the Emerald Sanctum and confront the corruption festering at the roots of the Emerald Dream.
phases.headline: Emerald Sanctum

phases.name: Phase 4
phases.blurb: Unite with the realm to complete the war effort and cleanse the ancient kingdom of Ahn'Qiraj.
phases.headline: Ahn'Qiraj

phases.name: Phase 5
phases.blurb: Enter the maw of the Timbermaw Hold and discover the darkness within.
phases.headline: Timbermaw Hold

phases.name: Phase 6
phases.blurb: Journey back to the Eastern Kingdoms to purge the necropolis of Naxxramas.
phases.headline: Naxxramas

phases.name: Phase 7
phases.blurb: The Tower of Karazhan is finally open. Are you prepared for what you'll find inside?
phases.headline: Karazhan

_zoneIdComment: Zone ids that appear in the data with no name are reported in data/meta.json under
unresolved.unnamedZoneIds. Add them here as id -> canonical name.
The 200-800 range is instance MAP ids: the database reports these instead of an area id for
some encounters. Naming them here does double duty, since a name that matches a phase's zone
list also gates that content correctly.

zoneIdOverrides._karazhanNote: 532 and 814 were once guessed as Karazhan zones here. Atlas contradicted that - the bosses concerned belong to Tower of Karazhan - and a wrong label silently pulled Phase 7 loot into launch. Instance naming now comes from Atlas; leave these unmapped.

_factionPhaseComment: Reputation rewards are only available once the faction is. Zandalar Tribe rep comes from
Zul'Gurub and Brood of Nozdormu from Ahn'Qiraj, so their rewards are not launch gear however
much the vendor looks like an ordinary one. Factions not listed are treated as launch, which is
_atlasSetPhaseComment: Fallback phase for Sets.lua entries, matched by name prefix (longest wins).
This only applies when an item has no source of its own. A tier piece that nothing in the crawl
drops still plainly belongs to its raid, and saying so is far better than the alternative: an
item with no phase at all used to fall back to launch, which put Naxxramas and Ahn'Qiraj gear
Sets that span phases - artifacts, legendaries, world blues, crafted sets - are deliberately
absent. Items in those stay unknown and are excluded from phase-gated views rather than guessed.
_questItemComment: Class quest rewards. These are unreachable by crawling: nothing drops them, no vendor sells
them, and the addon records the quests as prose rather than item ids. They are named here and
resolved through the database search, the same way scripted bosses are.
Keep this to items worth planning around - the level 60 class weapons and the well-known quest
chains. Anything a boss actually drops is found without help.

_craftingComment: Crafted gear is not discovered by crawling NPCs, so relevant recipes are named here and
resolved to item ids via database search. Keep this list to gear that is genuinely BiS-
contending; it is an editorial list, not an exhaustive one.
